name: vaultgate
description: Use the credentials in your Bitwarden or Vaultwarden vault without seeing them, through your own self-hosted vaultgate server.

interface.longDescription: vaultgate is a self-hosted gateway to your Bitwarden or Vaultwarden vault. ChatGPT names a target the operator defined (a web API, Microsoft Graph, a SQL Server or PostgreSQL database, an SSH or WinRM host, a GitHub repository for code search) and describes an operation; vaultgate injects the credential from the vault, runs the operation under the operator's policy and returns a result with every injected value removed. Vault tools return item metadata only, and the one tool that returns a secret value is a separate scope with every call audited. For people who run their own vaultgate: this plugin connects to the server named in its mcp.json, signs in through that server's own OAuth consent page, and can do only what the operator granted to ChatGPT there.
defaultPrompt: List the vaultgate targets I can use and what each one is for.
Check that the vault is connected and when it last synced.
Find the vault item for our GitHub account without revealing any secret.
